children: Sweden sleep tracking app's Q3 net sales fell 17% yr/yr, driven by weaker consumer app sales
Adjusted EBIT margin rose to 29.7%, but reported EBIT margin dropped to 2.2% due to one-off costs
B2B sales grew 49% yr/yr and now represent 20% of net sales
Sleep Cycle expects full-year 2026 adjusted operating margin of about 20% for current operations
Company expects reported operating margin of about 7% for 2026, including SEK 25 mln in comparability items
Company expects annual savings of about SEK 35 mln from reorganization, with significant impact in Q4
CONSUMER APP WEAKNESS - Co said net sales decline was driven by continued challenges in new consumer app sales
B2B GROWTH - Co said B2B revenue rose 49% and reached a record high, now accounting for 20% of net sales
RESTRUCTURING COSTS - Co said reported profit was reduced by SEK 14 mln in one-off costs related to CEO change and reorganization
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Sleep Cycle AB (publ) is SEK29.50, about 21.9% above its October 22 closing price of SEK24.20
The stock recently traded at 26 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 33 three months ago
